Bill.BriefDescription: Making the third violation of antiharassment protection order a class C felony.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to antiharassment protection orders; amending RCW10.14.170; and prescribing penalties.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecAmd.BegSecText: RCW 10.14.170 and 2001 c 260 s 5 are each amended to readas follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) Any respondent age eighteen years or over who willfullydisobeys any civil antiharassment protection order issued pursuant tothis chapter shall be guilty of a gross misdemeanor. (2) A violation of a protection order issued under this chapter isa class C felony if the offender has at least two previous convictionsfor violating the provisions of an order issued under this chapter.The previous convictions may involve the same victim or other victimsspecifically protected by the orders the offender violated.
